name: SK_Bonca_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic
base colour sRGB, colour variant "Brown" (shares N and ORM)
base colour sRGB, colour variant "Purple" (shares N and ORM)

rig.rest_pose: standing pose as modelled (not a T pose)
rig.animation: none: skeleton and skin weights only; no clips, no Physics Asset, no control rig
rig.skeleton: bespoke (CONVENTIONS.md section 11: any skeleton with a single root bone named root)

pivot: feet: armature origin on the ground between the feet, front on -Y
dresses: bonca: a hunched, neckless biped about 1.45 m at the hump and 2.5 m nose to tail tip; grey-green banded hide with pale fold crests, pale eyes low in the front of the trunk, wide slit mouth with peg teeth, three-clawed feet with a rear spur, thick tail
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound to any placement
known_weaknesses: NOT photoreal at 1 m: it reads as a carefully lit maquette, smooth and rubbery, and passes only at gameplay distance. Anatomy is invented from 90-pixel sprites: a blob of a trunk on a joint graph, with no modelled musculature, knees or ankle tendons; folds are a sine band pattern, not sculpted. The face is two amber eye domes, a displaced slit and nine peg teeth; no lids, nostrils, gums or tongue, and the mouth cannot open (no jaw bone). The game mesh is a decimation of the remeshed source, so it has no edge loops at the joints: it will crease when the legs and tail bend far. Skin weights are inverse-distance to the bones (bone heat did not solve on the multi-shell mesh), checked in one test pose only (render_pose.png). No animation clips, no Physics Asset. Smart-projected UVs: many islands, so mip seams are possible. The brown and purple hides are tints of the grey base colour, not separately painted.
